Welcome to Chaos & Majesty!


Gather round, denizens of the internet, for we have something to share.


A place was needed to collect thoughts, ideas, and projects. A place to share knowledge and learn. A place to be free. Fellow denizians, this is our place, welcome to our home.


Enjoy browsing some of our code on the site's Git mirror, the site itself is open source and available. There is also a base static site generator project that powers the site, which is also open source and available. I encourage you to build off of these projects. The "RadioStatic" site generator leans heavily into HTMX for responsive, dynamic content, while still serving only static content reducing potential attack vectors. The git mirrors can be configured to mirror single or multiple branches and can be configured to mirror curated branches of private repositories through CI/CD.


Every page is pre-rendered, every payload is deterministic, and every UI flourish is layered on top of static assets. By keeping runtime dependencies out of production we minimize the attack surface, shrink the footprint exposed to bots, and keep the trust boundary easy to reason about. The HTMX flows that power our blog and Git explorers are compiled into static fragments, so browsers only ever fetch first-party HTML, CSS, and JSON from the same origin.


For teams with compliance needs, the generator can be wired into CI to lint third-party resources, diff security headers, or snapshot the final HTML for offline review. Shipping static artifacts also means you can front the entire site with a CDN + WAF combo, disable origin server scripting entirely, and rotate mirrors or keys without redeploying the UI shell. If you fork this project, you inherit a hardened baseline that assumes a hostile network and keeps the surface lean.

...and you can play DOOM on it!
